title: Permanent electrostatic moments through the lens of atoms: assessing variational Hirshfeld methods
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5296-5308
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07866K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maximilian van Zyl, Carlos Castillo-Orellana, Leila Pujal, Farnaz Heidar-Zadeh
Atomic multipoles are key components of many computational models; however, there is no unique method for computing them. We compare the performance of variational Hirshfeld methods in reproducing molecular moments to identify the most accurate one.
